note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Start the age readers once the ledger lands", the age rules reaching young writers, producers and directors as well as performers; "It should cover across every country"; "Again I want depth covering every basis for every feature leaving NO STONE UNTURNED"): what age changes for screen work in Mongolia: the age of majority, the working age, how a minor's contract binds and what of the pay is set aside, a child performer's permit and hours, the unions', the funds' and the company law's ages. figures.finding: The Cinema Support Fund under the 2021 law gives non-repayable funding to projects (Mongolian history and culture, children's and young people's upbringing, international-festival entries showing a director's own artistry); a producer is defined as an individual or legal entity who initiates and organises a film's making, and no applicant age is set.
